concept: RDS Multi-AZ: automatic failover via the DNS endpoint
tests: Understanding how failover works in RDS Multi-AZ.
expected: RDS automatically fails over to a synchronously replicated standby in another AZ and updates the DNS endpoint — the app reconnects to the same endpoint. Triggers: "Multi-AZ", "what happens during failover".
why_not: No need to change the connection string manually; a cross-Region read replica is a separate feature; no snapshot restore is needed.
